name: Bungee jump
summary:
The Jump is Everything.
VR Bungee is a dedicated simulator focused entirely on the physics and sensation of a real jump.

What’s inside:
Real Sense of Height: I’ve tuned the scale of the world to make the drop feel massive. When you stand on the edge, your brain will tell you to stay back.

Physics-Based Fall: The acceleration and the cord's snap-back are calculated to mimic real-world movement. You will feel that classic "stomach-drop" sensation as the ground rushes toward you.
